name: Key Light Air
author: fgonzal
description: Control an Elgato Key Light Air from the Omarchy bar: power, brightness, and color temperature.

barWidget.description: Toggle the light and adjust brightness and color temperature from a panel.

schema.label: Light address
schema.description: Optional. IP address of the Key Light Air (e.g. 192.168.1.4) to skip mDNS discovery. Leave empty to find the light automatically.

schema.label: Background refresh (seconds)
schema.description: How often to re-read light state while the panel is closed, so the bar icon stays truthful.
